border.description: Draws the border around the scrolling table area

columns.description: Column definitions that specify how data should be rendered and behave

enableColumnFiltering.description: Adds a filter row under the header. Each column gets a search input unless its meta supplies a filterComponent

enableGlobalFiltering.description: Displays a search input that filters across all columns

enablePagination.description: Enables pagination controls at the bottom of the table

enableRowSelection.description: Adds a checkbox column with select-all. To control that column yourself, include one with the id "SdsTableSelectColumn" and it will be used instead of the generated one

enableSorting.description: Makes column headers sortable, wiring each one's chevron and click handler for you

onRowSelect.description: Callback triggered when row selection changes; receives array of selected row data

paginationConfig.description: Passed through to Pagination, plus a placement for the controls, which sit on the right by default. pageSize also sets the initial page size, which is 10 otherwise. Changing this object resets the table to the first page

shouldPinSelectRowToLeft.description: Pins the row selection column to the left/right side of the table

sdsStyle.description: Whether rows are separated by dividers or by alternating backgrounds

tableOptions.description: Escape hatch to the underlying TanStack table. Anything here is merged into its options, and a state you supply overrides the one the component keeps, which is how you drive sorting or pagination from outside. The row models and change handlers are always the component's own

tableRowProps.description: Additional props to pass to each table row component

data.description: Array of data objects to display in the table rows

className.description: CSS class name to apply to the table container

style.description: Inline styles to apply to the table container

tableWidth.description: Sets the width of the table container

pinning.description: Sticks the column to that edge while the table scrolls sideways, with a gradient at the edge once there is something hidden behind it

verticalAlign.description: Vertical alignment of the column's cells

widthPercentage.description: The column's share of the table width, as a percentage rather than a fixed size

isGrow.description: Lets this column absorb whatever width the others leave over

headerCellProps.description: Props for the CellHeader generated from a string header, for tooltips, alignment or truncation

filterComponent.description: Replaces the default search input in this column's filter cell, for a select or a range instead
